commit.message:
Queue three related-work citations for v2, found by KB probe

Eppstein 2301.09246 disproves a Gethner conjecture on biplanarity of
2-blowups - directly related work v1 missed. His independent 2-blowup is a
different construction from our clique product C_m x K_t, so no v1 claim is
undercut, including the novelty of section 3.3a. Also Noguchi 2603.27968
(March 2026, product thickness, completes Yan12) and Biniaz 2008.05186
(short proof of theta(K9)=3).

Same probe confirmed Postle's k=12 case is still open as of today, which is
what section 7.2 claims.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01QdPjmmm1MFYd6jXiM6FqXK

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+# Queue for v2
+
+Found 2026-08-26 by probing the updated Math KB (now 1.46M papers) with the
+campaign's open questions. None of these undercuts a v1 claim; all three belong
+in v2's related work.
+
+## Citations to add
+
+**D. Eppstein, *On the Biplanarity of Blowups*, arXiv:2301.09246 (2023).**
+Disproves Gethner's conjecture that 2-blowups of planar graphs are biplanar
+(iterated Kleetopes are counterexamples). Directly related work our v1 missed:
+a modern biplanarity result answering a Gethner conjecture. Important
+distinction that keeps our novelty claims intact: his 2-blowup replaces each
+vertex by two NON-adjacent copies (independent blowup, G[K2-bar]); our section
+3.3a kills the CLIQUE product C_m x K_t = C_m[K_t]. Different construction,
+no chromatic-number angle in his paper. Our "C7 x K4 untested by any prior
+work" claim stands, but v2 should cite this next to the Gethner discussion.
+
+**K. Noguchi, *Note on the thickness of the Cartesian product of a complete
+graph and a path*, arXiv:2603.27968 (March 2026).**
+Determines theta(K_n x P_m) for the Cartesian product. Supersedes/completes
+the Yang result we cite as [Yan12]. Cite alongside Yan12 in the
+product-thickness paragraph.
+
+**A. Biniaz, *A short proof of the non-biplanarity of K9*, arXiv:2008.05186.**
+Modern short proof of theta(K9) = 3, which v1 uses repeatedly via
+Battle-Harary-Kodama and Tutte. Supplementary citation for section 3.2.
+
+## Confirmed still open (probed, nothing found)
+
+- Postle's conjecture at k = 12 (K10-free 12-critical density with eps > 1/11):
+  the probe returned exactly the known cases - k = 5 (1602.03098), the
+  local-eps Reed version (1911.02672), Gould-Larsen-Postle structure
+  (2107.00976). Section 7.2's "k = 12 is open" claim stands as of 2026-08-26.
+- No technique fingerprint in ~885K papers matches the section 3.3a
+  Euler-counting argument shape. Weak positive evidence of novelty, within
+  the corpus boundary (arXiv-only: Zenodo, Springer chapters, pre-1991
+  literature remain invisible - the Doria lesson).
